## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] Public API / behavior changes documented (README / CHANGELOG)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or large data files committed
- [ ] The math kernel (RH / positivity / moments) is unchanged, or the change is justified
